report_metadata.blended_cost_formula: input + 2 * output (USD per 1M tokens, indicative for coding-style workloads with ~1:2 input:output ratio)
report_metadata.sorting: providers within each model are sorted by blended cost ascending (cheapest first)
notes_global: All prices are USD per 1,000,000 tokens unless stated otherwise.
Cache-hit price reflects prompt-cache read discount when documented by the provider; null means either no cache support or not publicly disclosed at the time of check.

Kilo Code advertises 'no markup over underlying provider rates' but their displayed price for DeepSeek V4 Pro and Grok 4.5 is the underlying OpenRouter / provider list, which can differ from the official creator's price (e.g. post-promo).
Grok 4.5 was released on 2026-07-08 (4 days before this snapshot) and is not yet listed in the Kilo Code xAI model catalog as of 2026-07-12.

providers.promotion_details: 75% launch discount (Apr 26 - May 31 2026 15:59 UTC) was made permanent on 2026-05-31. Listed V4 Pro price is now 1/4 of the original launch list price.
providers.notes: Official creator price. V4-Pro cache-miss input $0.435, output $0.87, cache-hit $0.003625 (per 1M). Confirmed via api-docs.deepseek.com on 2026-07-12.
